findings.one_line: The claimed panel-inference positioning is plausible and the interval is evaluable, but the related-work text gives no relevance or theorem-level comparison for several bibliography entries (including Andrews--Mikusheva, Bai--Ng, the Choi--Kwon--Liao papers, Cattaneo et al., Ben-Michael--Feller, Bordino et al., and IEEE 754); add targeted sentences explaining why each is included and how the main coverage/length result differs from the closest classes.
